thread:
Anna Rodriguez: Uploading weights + tokenizer from partner 'OpenAtlas' to staging S3. Need provenance + checksum verification before we start onboarding. Manifest & basic notes below. :eyes:

Kevin Park: Cool — drop the S3 links and sha256s. Also need KMS wrapping and a model_card draft. Priority? any SLA/latency target?

Anna Rodriguez: s3://redwood-ingest/staging/openatlas/v1/
manifest.json snippet:
```
{
  "name": "openatlas-v1",
  "artifact_id": "art-20260402-001",
  "weights": "openatlas-weights-20260402.ckpt",
  "tokenizer": "openatlas-tokenizer.json",
  "sha256": "3a7f9b6c...e4f1"
}
```
S3 objects: weights (12.3GB), tokenizer (1.2MB). License: permissive but CLA required.

Sarah Li: I'll run checksum + signature verification. Also need the original source URL + publisher identity. What tokenizer type? BPE/Unigram?

Anna Rodriguez: BPE (merges file included). tokenizer sha256: b5d2f3c9...fa01. Source URL: https://partner.openatlas/models/v1/weights.tar.gz. Publisher: OpenAtlas Inc.

Maya Patel: Propose quant experiments early: GPTQ int8, nf4 (q4_0), and 4-bit PTQ baseline. Priority scoring: latency gain vs quality risk. I'll run a quick sweep on a small eval set.

Kevin Park: Set overall priority: MED-HIGH. Onboarding checklist (quick): 1) provenance & sha checks, 2) KMS wrapping + access policy, 3) model_card + license, 4) bias/regression evals, 5) quant experiments + perf/quality matrix, 6) registry entry + tagging, 7) canary rollout plan.

ci-bot: artifact-uploader: upload complete for art-20260402-001. size=12.3GB, objects=3, status=staged.

Anna Rodriguez: Assigning tasks: @Sarah Li you own ingest + ledger entry; @Maya Patel you own quant sweep + evals. Can we reserve dedicated GPU time for the quant runs next week? :calendar:

Sarah Li: Reserved slot p3x2 on Wed 10:00-14:00 for int8/nf4 runs. I'll run: 1) sha256 verification, 2) verify tokenizer tokenization of canonical prompts, 3) KV-cache load test on 2k seq. Will attach run_ids.

Maya Patel: I'll spin up eval harness (eval-set: prod_prompts_v2) and compare to baseline 'rw-base-1.2'. Plan: accuracy/LL/perplexity + embed-sim regression + human-quality sample. Will post a perf table and delta heatmap.

Kevin Park: Also ensure we wrap weights with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-ef01 and add IAM policy restricting get_object to infra and eng-ml roles.

Anna Rodriguez: Thanks — tagging product for go/no-go @Hector Gomes

Hector Gomes: Acknowledged. Rule of thumb: if quant yields >=2x cost reduction and <1% quality degradation on our primary eval, we greenlight dedicated + canary. Otherwise keep in staging and run more evals.

Sarah Li: Checksum run complete. weight sha256 matches manifest. tokenizer verified on canonical prompts. KV-cache mem usage and throughput within expected. Created ledger entry onboard-1849501123 with run_id run-7782.

Maya Patel: Preliminary quant results uploaded: int8 -> latency x2.1 cost drop, quality delta +0.4% (better) on some prompts; nf4 (q4_0) -> latency x1.9 cost drop, quality delta -0.8%. Attaching summary table and sample outputs.

Kevin Park: Good signals. Next steps: 1) create registry tag 'partner/openatlas-v1', 2) add provenance fields: original_url, publisher, license, manifest_sha, ledger_id, 3) plan canary route with fallback to rw-base-1.2.

Anna Rodriguez: Done: registry tag created partner/openatlas-v1, provenance attached. :white_check_mark:

Hector Gomes: If Maya's final runs after extended eval keep quality within threshold, we schedule canary deploy next Tue. Please prepare rollback metrics and alerting hooks.

Anna Rodriguez: Will do. Thanks team :thumbsup:
